snippet.title: Petit Planet - Cozy Cosmos Trailer | Weave Your Dreams Beneath the Stars
snippet.description:
When you gaze up at the stars, have you ever dreamed of having a planet to call your own? 
Here, craft your ideal life—plan and build, plant and harvest, befriend quirky fuzzy neighbors, and infuse your world with the magical essence of Luca. Answer the call to explore distant galaxies and encounter wonders among the stars...

Now, get ready to see that dream come alive in Petit Planet, the brand-new cosmic life sim by HoYoverse!

▌Petit Planet Coziness Test is now open for sign-ups!

Head to the official Petit Planet website → Press the "Beta Sign-Up" button on the homepage → Log in with your HoYoverse Account → Complete the survey for a chance to join the test.

Sign up now: https://hoyo.link/EodPnWZcn

▌Follow us for the latest updates and announcements:
X: https://twitter.com/PetitPlanetGame
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/petitplanetgame
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@petitplanet
Discord: https://discord.gg/petitplanetofficial
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/PetitPlanetGame
